comment: Recorded-response fixtures for tests/grower.test.js and tests/grow_server.test.js (LOCAL_LLM.md §5.7 payoff 3, §7). `props` stands in for GET /props; `completions` maps the source state's action — the last `"action"` of the rendered branch.v4 prompt — to the lines the stub returns, one per draw, in draw order (cycling when a caller draws more). A source with no entry is a fixture gap and fails the request. Designed to exercise: a grown-to-grown merge (shelter(red, cottage) drawn on two parallel paths) and a grown-to-SEED merge (arrive(red, grandmother_house) is red_arrive's own action). The two merge cases use different actions on purpose: seeds v2 made arrive(red, grandmother_house) a real seed node, which silently turned an earlier grown-to-grown case into a grown-to-seed one and cost the test its subject. shelter(red, cottage) appears in no seed and must stay that way. Shapes match what the reference server emits (stop_type eos, stopped_limit null).

send(mother, red, basket).state: Red is at home. The basket has not left the house.
Red and her mother are walking into the woods together, carrying the basket.

escort(mother, red).state: Red and her mother are back at the treeline, heading home.
Red is at a woodsman's cottage, waiting for better light.

refuse(red, mother).state: Red is at her grandmother's house.
Red is at a woodsman's cottage, waiting for better light.
